days.title: Tofane Massifs and Geological Wonders
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tofane
stops.detail: The oldest formations of the area, located in the zones at the base of the Cristallo and Tofane massifs, are made of clay and marl very rich in fossil records.

stops.name: Busc de Tofana
stops.detail: A geomorphological curiosity is, finally, the presence of some holes that pierce the rock forming very particular ring shapes, resulting from erosion phenomena on thin limestone ridges (two typical examples are the Busc de Tofana and the Busc de r'Ancona).

stops.name: altopiano di Fosses
stops.detail: Both the dolomite and limestone formations can be subject to karst phenomena (the limestone pavement phenomenon), which generates complex networks of underground caves up to a maximum depth of one kilometer (Fosses plateau, caves under Rozes and Cima Fanes).

days.title: Peaks and Gorges of the Northern Park
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: monte Cristallo
stops.detail: The park's territory includes many famous Dolomite groups: mount Cristallo, the Tofane, the Fanes peak, Col Bechei and the Croda Rossa d'Ampezzo, respectively divided by the Travenanzes Valley, Fanes Valley, upper Boite Valley and Felizon Valley.

stops.name: Gola di Fanes
stops.detail: This particular scenario takes the name Gola di Fanes.
